title: Chiang Mai Elephant Camp, Bamboo Raft & Hill Tribes Day Tour
highlights: Hotel pickup in Chiang Mai city
description: A full day from Chiang Mai city hotels: elephant camp safari vibes, bamboo rafting on the Mae Taeng river, an art stop, and unhurried hill-tribe villages including Long Neck communities.
itinerary: 09:15 Elephant camp — care, show & ride experience

title: Chiang Mai 3 Days 2 Nights Private Group
highlights: Doi Inthanon — highest peak in Thailand
Khun Khantoke dinner with Lanna show
description: Private Chiang Mai immersion with Doi Inthanon, Mon Jam skywalk, Hinoki Land, Sirikit Botanical Garden, Mae Kampong village, Doi Kham and more — Driver Guide, hotels and flights coordination as in the program.
itinerary: Day 1: Fly in · Doi Inthanon · overnight Mon Jam area
Day 2: Mon Jam skywalk · Wat Den Salee · Hinoki Land · Botanical Garden · Khantoke dinner · overnight Tha Phae
Day 3: Mae Kampong · Doi Kham · Wat Umong · cafe stop · fly out

title: Doi Suthep Temple & City Viewpoint Half-Day Tour
highlights: Wat Phra That Doi Suthep golden chedi
Back in the old city by early afternoon
description: The short introduction to Chiang Mai: a mountain road up to the city's most revered temple, the golden chedi of Wat Phra That Doi Suthep, and a viewpoint over the whole Ping valley. Easy pace, back in town for lunch.
itinerary: 08:30 Hotel pickup in Chiang Mai city
09:15 Doi Suthep mountain road · viewpoint stop
09:45 Wat Phra That Doi Suthep with guide
11:30 Free time for photos and coffee

title: Doi Inthanon, Twin Pagodas & Karen Village Day Tour
highlights: Doi Inthanon summit and nature trail
Ban Mae Klang Luang rice terraces & village coffee
description: A full day on the highest mountain in Thailand. Cool air, a big waterfall, the Royal Twin Pagodas with their mountain gardens, and a Karen village where the rice terraces run right up to the coffee plots.
itinerary: 07:30 Hotel pickup in Chiang Mai city
11:00 Doi Inthanon summit · Ang Ka nature trail
13:30 Royal Twin Pagodas (Phra Mahathat Napamethanidol & Napaphonphumisiri)
15:00 Ban Mae Klang Luang rice terraces and coffee stop

title: Elephant Care & Pha Dok Siew Trail Day Tour
highlights: Pha Dok Siew nature trail with a Karen guide
Village lunch and highland coffee tasting
description: For guests who want elephants without a ride: watch and feed the herd at a Karen-run camp in the morning, then walk the Pha Dok Siew trail through rice terraces and coffee plots to the waterfall with a village guide.
itinerary: 07:30 Hotel pickup in Chiang Mai city
09:30 Elephant observation, feeding and learning about care
11:30 Transfer into Doi Inthanon National Park
12:30 Lunch in Ban Mae Klang Luang
13:30 Pha Dok Siew trail walk (~2 hours, easy to moderate)

title: Doi Inthanon Private Charter — Car or Van
highlights: Private air-con car or van, price per vehicle
Waterfalls, summit and pagodas at your own pace
Guide optional — driver only keeps the cost down
description: Your own vehicle and driver for the Doi Inthanon loop, so you set the pace and pick the stops. Priced per vehicle rather than per person, which usually works out cheaper for families and small groups.
itinerary: 08:00 Hotel pickup (or the time you prefer)
Doi Inthanon summit and Ang Ka nature trail
Royal Twin Pagodas and mountain gardens
Optional: Mae Ya Waterfall, Karen village, coffee farm
Back in Chiang Mai after 7–8 hours

title: Phu Chi Fa Day Tour from Chiang Rai
highlights: Optional Phu Chi Dao & Phu Chi Duean 4WD
description: Climb the Chiang Rai highland ridge to Phu Chi Fa (1,628 m) with optional 4WD visits to Phu Chi Dao and Phu Chi Duean for Thailand–Laos panoramic views.
itinerary: 12:00 Lunch · continue to Phu Chi Dao (local 4WD extra)

title: Chiang Rai Temples & Doi Mae Mon Day Tour
highlights: Wat Huay Pla Kang (Big Buddha / Guan Yin)
description: Iconic Chiang Rai temples plus Doi Mae Mon valley views and Boon Rawd Farm — a classic private day from Chiang Rai city or airport.
itinerary: White Temple · Doi Mae Mon · Mae Mon Valley

title: Chiang Rai Doi Chang & Doi Pha Hee 4 Days 3 Nights
highlights: Golden Triangle & Chiang Saen Sky Walk
Doi Tung Mae Fah Luang Garden
Doi Chang coffee village overnight area
White Temple · Singha Park · Choui Fong · Blue Temple
description: Highland Chiang Rai: Golden Triangle & Chiang Saen, Doi Tung gardens, Doi Chang coffee hills, overnight cliff village Doi Pha Hee, White Temple, Singha Park, Choui Fong tea and Blue Temple.
itinerary: Day 1: Chiang Rai airport · Chiang Saen · Golden Triangle · Doi Tung · overnight
Day 2: Doi Chang Mub viewpoint · Doi Pha Mee · Doi Chang
Day 3: Doi Chang · White Temple · Singha Park · Wat Huay Pla Kang
Day 4: Choui Fong · Mae Sai · Blue Temple · airport

title: White Temple, Blue Temple & Black House Day Tour
highlights: Wat Huay Pla Kang and the Big Buddha viewpoint
description: Chiang Rai's four landmark art sites in one private day: Chalermchai's white temple, the sapphire blue hall of Wat Rong Suea Ten, Thawan Duchanee's Black House, and the nine-tier pagoda at Wat Huay Pla Kang.

title: Golden Triangle, Mae Sai Border & Hall of Opium Day Tour
highlights: Mae Sai — northernmost point of Thailand
Golden Triangle viewpoint at Sop Ruak
Hall of Opium museum · optional Mekong longtail boat
description: North to the edge of the country: the White Temple on the way up, the northernmost point of Thailand at Mae Sai, and the Mekong bend at Sop Ruak where Thailand, Laos and Myanmar meet.
itinerary: 10:00 Mae Sai border market and northernmost marker
13:30 Golden Triangle viewpoint · optional boat to Don Sao (Laos)
15:00 Hall of Opium or Opium Hall museum

title: Choui Fong Tea & Doi Chang Coffee Day Tour
highlights: Choui Fong tea terraces and hillside cafe
Doi Chang coffee village and roastery
Wat Rong Suea Ten on the way back
description: A slow day through the hills that grow Chiang Rai's two famous exports. Walk the terraced tea rows at Choui Fong, then climb to the Doi Chang villages where the arabica is washed and roasted.
itinerary: 09:30 Choui Fong tea plantation · tea tasting
13:30 Coffee farm walk, washing station and roastery
15:30 Wat Rong Suea Ten photo stop

title: Chiang Rai 7 Highlights Join-In Day Tour
highlights: Baan Dam Museum and Wat Huay Pla Kang
Singha Park, Wat Phra Kaew and the clock tower
description: The budget way to see Chiang Rai: a shared air-con van covering seven landmarks in one day, from the White Temple to Singha Park and the golden clock tower in town.
itinerary: 08:00 Pickup from the meeting point or your hotel in town
16:30 Wat Phra Kaew and the golden clock tower

title: Krabi Emerald Pool & Hot Spring Day Tour
description: Swim in the natural Emerald Pool, soak at the hot springs, and visit Tiger Cave Temple on a classic Krabi land day.

title: Krabi 7 Islands Sunset Tour
description: Afternoon boat to Chicken Island, Thale Waek sandbar, Poda Island and more — finish with a Krabi sunset and buffet.
itinerary: 13:30–14:00 Pickup Ao Nang / town / Khlong Muang

Day 3: Breakfast · ferry return · airport transfer

description: Speedboat into Ang Thong National Park — snorkel, kayak, Viewpoint / Emerald Lake area and island photo stops from Koh Samui.
